changelog:
v1.25.3 - Resolve the open bugs.md issues (all headless-verified, 27/27 assertions in a new Godot 4.6.2 `--script` test suite):
v1.25.2 - Add a Config-First Mandate to architecture.md §1.1 (Principle of Configurability): any change expressible through the config JSONs must be made there rather than in code — e.g. rebalancing an enemy/weapon is an `enemies_config.json`/`weapons_config.json` edit, not a script edit — and code is touched only when configuration genuinely cannot carry the change.
v1.25.1 - Integrate user feedback in bugs.md and features.md: add exponential poison scaling, reopen diagonal road graphical glitch, semi-transparent ghost XP orbs, broken keyboard rebinding menu, and ranged attack targeting constraint bugs; add floating player health bar feature request.
